title: Observation of Tunable Superradiant Frequency Combs
summary: Cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) with quantum emitters coupled to resonators provides a powerful platform for engineering light-matter interactions and exploring collective phenomena. In particular, superradiance, arising from collective quantum interference among emitters, has been explored as a route to ultrastable continuous radiation. However, engineering superradiance in the time domain to realize periodic pulsed sources or frequency combs remains largely unexplored.
